family.shared_definition: a woven container used for holding, sorting, or carrying household goods
family.neutral_stem: Before heading to the laundry room, she sorted clothes into
family.semantic_notes: Hamper usually denotes a tall lidded laundry container or picnic food basket, while basket is the universal woven container term.

source_context_dev: Muddy soccer uniforms and grimy gardening overalls had accumulated in a messy pile on the mudroom floor. She wanted to keep the heavily soiled items separate from ordinary daily wear.
The kitchen dishcloths were stained with grease and smelled faintly sour after a weekend of heavy cooking. She gathered every stained rag across the counter.
After weeding the backyard garden, all the stained work pants and grass-smeared shirts needed immediate attention. She needed a quick holder to carry the grubby garments.
The children had tracked mud all over their play clothes during recess in the rain. She picked up each damp, stained piece from the entryway.
target_context_dev: A massive backlog of linens, towels, and bedding from four guest rooms needed to be washed all at once. The pile of laundry was enormous and required maximum holding capacity.
Three weeks of accumulated household textiles created a towering mountain of fabric in the master closet. She gathered everything into an oversized receptacle designed for bulk loads.
Hosting the extended family over the holidays left dozens of heavy bath towels and duvet covers waiting to be washed. She needed a tall, spacious unit capable of handling full loads.
The entire household's weekly wash had to be collected in a single trip down the hallway. A spacious, high-volume unit stood ready in the corner of the bedroom.
source_context_test: Greasy garage coveralls and engine-oil rags needed to be gathered separately before they stained anything else. She quickly scooped up the grimiest items from the floor.
Sweaty gym apparel and damp running shorts had been sitting in the workout bag for two days. She grabbed the smelly load to begin treating the stains.
Food spills and coffee splatters covered the kitchen aprons and table linens after the dinner party. She gathered all the soiled fabrics into a portable organizer.
A pile of muddy camping gear and soiled trail towels sat near the back entrance. She gathered the grit-covered textiles together to prepare them for a heavy wash cycle.
target_context_test: Every sheet and blanket from the upstairs bedrooms had been stripped for the seasonal deep clean. The massive bundle of heavy textiles required a receptacle with immense volume.
Doing laundry for a family of six meant processing multiple bulky loads in a single morning. She turned toward the colossal corner receptacle that stored days of apparel.
Heavy winter coats, thick fleece throws, and oversized comforters took up substantial space in the hallway. She gathered the bulky heap into an expansive tall container.
A week of neglected laundry had produced an immense pile of clothing across the dressing room. She dragged over the deep, wide storage unit to fit everything at once.
constructions.semantic_audit_notes: All combinations (dirty basket, dirty hamper, large basket, large hamper) remain natural and semantically compatible with clothes sorting before entering a laundry room. Low leverage reflects subtle thematic shift from soil-focused sorting to bulk-volume accumulation.

source_context_dev: She went up to the neglected attic where spare seasonal linens had been sitting untouched on open rafters for months. A fine layer of grey particles coated the long-stored items.
Old cloth napkins and vintage aprons were retrieved from the back corner of the unfinished basement storage shelf. Everything smelled faintly of age and was covered in fine grit.
The guest bedroom quilts had rested undisturbed in the unused wardrobe since last winter, gathering a visible powdery film. She took them down to freshen them up.
Unwashed drop cloths and forgotten storage covers had rested in the garage corner all through the dry summer. She retrieved the grit-coated fabric to run a refresh cycle.
target_context_dev: She separated delicate silk blouses and featherweight lace camisoles that required gentle handling and minimal bulk. The entire bundle weighed practically nothing.
A small batch of breezy summer linens and sheer curtains needed to be carried effortlessly down the stairs. The pale, featherweight batch was easy to lift.
Only a few thin handkerchiefs, baby garments, and airy scarves needed washing this afternoon. She placed the low-weight assortment into the portable unit.
Delicate chiffon dresses and featherweight undergarments were gathered for a quick gentle cycle. She needed something that was effortless to carry across the house.
source_context_test: Retrieving antique tablecloths from the high closet shelf sent a small cloud of grey particles into the air. The vintage fabrics had sat neglected in the dry air for years.
The curtains from the renovated spare room had absorbed plaster powder and fine debris during the drywall work. She gathered the grimy drapes to be thoroughly shaken out.
Forgotten winter blankets in the garage cabinet were covered in a fine layer of grey grime after months of neglect. She pulled the stale textiles from the dark corner.
Old fabric scraps kept in the utility shed had gathered cobwebs and fine powder along their edges. She collected the long-abandoned textiles for an overdue washing.
target_context_test: Handling fine lace doilies and gossamer nightgowns required sorting them separately from standard clothing. The airy collection had virtually zero heft.
A quick refresh of baby clothes and airy pastel shirts involved carrying just a couple of ounces of fabric. She packed the featherweight items together.
She picked out the sheer voile panels and wispy summer scarves for a mild rinse. The entire batch of fabric felt as weightless as a feather in her arms.
Only two sheer blouses and a few delicate silk scarves made up this afternoon's tiny wash batch. The pale, easy-to-carry assortment was ready for transport.
constructions.semantic_audit_notes: All four combinations (dusty basket, dusty hamper, light basket, light hamper) are fully grammatical and contextually plausible. The medium condition shifts focus from neglected, attic-stored storage to delicate, low-weight wash assortments.

source_context_dev: The farmhouse interior featured handcrafted timber furnishings and rustic stave containers arranged neatly throughout the utility area. She appreciated sturdy, natural timber craftsmanship.
She walked past the carved cedar organizers and timber storage chests that lined the hallway. Her favorite handmade oak carrier sat beside the antique vanity.
In keeping with the rustic cabin decor, natural timber slats and carved birch accents were used for all storage containers in the master suite.
The historic homestead was filled with handmade timber wares and carved ash utility goods crafted by local carpenters. She reached for the sturdy timber unit.
target_context_dev: Garments were tumbling over the brim and spilling onto the floor because laundry had been completely ignored for over two weeks. Piles of apparel surged past the top edges.
Every single garment from the closet seemed to be spilling past the rim in an uncontrollable cascade of fabric. The container could barely contain the bursting heap.
Clothes were bursting over the sides and spilling onto the bedroom rug in towering mounds. The excessive load had exceeded its boundaries hours ago.
Sheets, pants, and sweaters were tumbling out over the edges in a chaotic, bulging heap that threatened to collapse onto the floor.
source_context_test: Natural grain timber chests and carved cedar storage bins gave the dressing area a warm, handcrafted aesthetic. She admired the solid oak joinery in the corner.
Her rustic decor relied heavily on polished birch staves and handmade timber crates placed along the dressing room wall. She selected the sturdy timber unit.
Traditional woodworking was showcased in every room, from carved pine boxes to hand-hewn cedar storage pieces. She turned toward the handsome timber container.
The mountain lodge was outfitted with handcrafted timber storage boxes made from local pine planks. She moved toward the solid timber holder beside the armoire.
target_context_test: Apparel was spilling uncontrollably over the edges, creating a teetering mound of garments that cascaded down onto the rug. The capacity had been exceeded completely.
A bulging mass of fabrics rose well above the rim, with shirts and socks tumbling out onto the hardwood floor. The container was hopelessly stuffed past capacity.
Dozens of discarded garments formed a teetering pinnacle that leaned precariously over the rim. She tried to balance the spilling mass before it toppled over.
The laundry pile had swelled so high that sleeves and pant legs were draping down to the carpet on all four sides. The receptacle was bursting past its capacity.
constructions.semantic_audit_notes: All combinations (wooden basket, wooden hamper, overflowing basket, overflowing hamper) are coherent and common in domestic contexts. High leverage leverages structural material properties against capacity limit states.
